Here we implemented previously described metrics like the coefficient of variation20,21 and differential expression-based metrics (Methods). Importantly, these metrics are dataset agnostic, in that they do not require dataset-specific informa- tion (such as cell-type labels or sample metadata) and are, therefore, broadly applicable.
